evidence_cards.content:
SmartBid provides users with the ability to set a maximum bid amount and have the system bid for them automatically (according to the minimum bid increment) until they win the auction or meet their maximum bid. Need bid confirmation popup. Possible SmartBid amounts are listed in a dropdown list. After placing and confirming their bid, the user will remain on the bidding page. There will be a question mark icon/link next to the button; users who click on it will be taken to the paragraph on the FAQ page that explains SmartBids.
 Bid Confirmation Pop-up: When customers bid from this page, a bid confirmation pop-up message will appear, telling the customer that they have just bid “\$XX, using a “[type] bid”. For example, “You are bidding \$30 for this item using a SmartBid,

The seller may not bid personally or through an agent. Also known as an auction without reserve.

- **Bid**: A prospective buyer’s indication or offer of a price he or she will pay to purchase an item at auction. Bids are usually in standardized increments established by the auctioneer. In virtually all auctions, bids are considered binding legal "offers" to purchase the auctioned item if the bid becomes the winning bid.

- **Bid Increment**: The amount by which a current high bid must be increased in order for the new bid to be accepted; i.e., the minimum increase. This will vary by item, and can be influenced by a number of factors, including item cost, length of auction, product category, etc.

- **Bid Retraction**: Bid Cancellation.
